title: HB98 (2024 General): Firearm Access Amendments

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Utah) (gun-policy Stage 5, Utah); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Utah text (Introduced, ; official copy, https://le.utah.gov/~2024/bills/hbillint/HB0098.pdf (Open States text id 90103160))
provenance.note: Introduced version (12-29-23); no later amendments in the text read. Section enacted whole; printed with add marks.

operative_text:
Section 1 (new Utah Code 76-10-502.5): (2) When an owner or authorized user is not lawfully possessing or using a firearm, the owner or authorized user shall: (a) store the firearm in a locked container; or (b) secure the firearm by a locking device that renders the firearm inoperable by an individual other than the owner or authorized user.
Section 1 (new Utah Code 76-10-502.5): (3) If an owner or authorized user fails to comply with the requirements of Subsection (2) and a restricted person, minor, or at-risk individual accesses the firearm, the owner or authorized user: (a) is subject to a civil fine of $1,000; or (b) is subject to a civil fine of $5,000 if the restricted person, minor, or at-risk individual uses the firearm in the commission of a crime or causes an injury to an individual with the firearm.
Section 1 (new Utah Code 76-10-502.5): (4) Subsection (3) does not apply if: (a) the firearm is accessed and used in a lawful act of self-defense; or (b) the owner or authorized user of the firearm reported the firearm as stolen to a law enforcement agency.
